name: Livermore-Pleasanton Fire Department Fire Explorer Post #933
what_you_do: Explorers train with firefighters on hose and ladder work, search and rescue, basic medical care and fire safety. They also volunteer at fire department events like Fill the Boot and Toys for Tots.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 21 with a real interest in a fire service career. You must commit time to training and community service.
duration: Full-day training on the 2nd and 4th Sundays of each month (8 a.m. to 5 p.m. per the brochure) at the LPFD Training Center and fire stations.
deadline_text: No application deadline or cost is stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Fill out and sign the Explorer application on the LPFD Explorers page. Information left off the application will not be considered. A resume is welcome but does not replace the application. Questions: explorers@lpfire.org or (925) 454-2361.
notes: Run with Scouting America (Boy Scouts of America) since 1999. Explorers must attend regularly, act professionally and do community service. Trainings build on each other, so missing sessions makes it harder. LPFD serves both Livermore and Pleasanton; the office is at 3560 Nevada Street, Pleasanton.
